messages:
incident-bot: PAGED @oncall-rohit — multiple CUDA OOMs detected on decode-stream nodes (us-west-2). High error spike for streaming endpoints, routing failures observed.

oncall-rohit: On it. Can someone paste the error snippets?

sre-anna: Logs: `ERROR cuda: out of memory when allocating 1.2GiB for kv-cache (decode-stream-3)` repeated across 3 nodes. Followed by container crash and kube restart loop.

eng-runtime-jay: Confirmed. This looks like runaway generation — a few requests are coming in with max_tokens=20000 and no streaming backpressure. Our per-request runtime cap isn't being applied for `streaming_v2` routes.

ops-miguel: Impact matrix: ~12% of streaming requests 500/503 in last 6m from prod region. Some customers reporting partial chunks then disconnect.

support-zoe: CS reports 2 customers (enterprise) filing errors and one started a rollback on their side. Ticket IDs linked.

product-ops-liz: Are we auto-failing to CPU fallback? We should fallback before OOM.

eng-runtime-jay: We have a fallback but it doesn't trigger fast enough because the OOM occurs during KV allocation mid-decode. Need an immediate mitigation: enforce max_tokens and buffered token caps at the gateway level + stop accepting new streaming sessions to decode pool for now.

oncall-rohit: Agreed. Do we have a quick patch we can push?

eng-runtime-jay: Hotpatch plan: 1) Push a gateway rule to cap `max_tokens_per_request=2048` and `max_buffered_tokens=4096` for streaming routes. 2) Add a temporary admission reject for requests with `max_tokens>2048` returning 400 with explanation. 3) Restart decode-stream deployment rolling with pause to avoid thundering restarts.

sre-anna: I'll run the restart and gate rule. Command: ```bash
# apply gateway caps
curl -X POST "$GATEWAY_API/admin/rules" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","rules":{"max_tokens":2048,"max_buffered_tokens":4096}}'
# then restart decode pods
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/decode-streamers
```

ops-miguel: Doing the gateway POST now. Response 200. Rule active in ~10s.

support-zoe: Messaging to customers: short heads-up prepared — telling them we applied throttling and working on safe auto-fallback. Draft available for review.

eng-runtime-jay: Rolling restart started. I'll watch for OOM counts and pod restarts. If OOMs persist we'll scale + spin spare nodes and temporarily divert new streaming traffic to CPU decode cluster for non-low-latency customers.

sre-anna: OOMs dropped to near zero within 30s of gateway rule. Some pods restarted cleanly and are healthy. Error rate for streaming endpoints down to baseline.

oncall-rohit: Nice. What about root cause next steps? We should avoid repeated incidents.

eng-runtime-jay: Root cause hypothesis: missing runtime enforcement for `streaming_v2` path combined with a client sending extremely large max_tokens (maybe mis-specified). We'll add server-side hard caps in runtime config and an early pre-alloc guard that rejects before allocating large KV caches. Also add telemetry to capture offending request shapes.

product-ops-liz: Also add a default soft cap in SDKs and examples to discourage huge max_tokens.

support-zoe: CS will follow up with affected customers; offering temporary higher-tier CPU fallback if they need longer generations in the short term.

ops-miguel: Filed follow-ups: INF-4987 (runtime pre-alloc guard), INF-4988 (gateway rule permanence + testing), INF-4989 (telemetry for large-token clients).

eng-runtime-jay: Proposed short-term config patch to runtime: ```json
{"streaming_defaults": {"max_tokens_per_request": 1024, "max_buffered_tokens": 2048, "reject_on_prealloc": true}}
``` We'll stage to prod after smoke tests.

oncall-rohit: Thanks team. Calling incident mitigated. I'll keep channel open for a couple more hours and then move to postmortem. Please attach logs and timing to INF-4987. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident status set to RESOLVED (mitigated) by oncall-rohit. Duration 00:27:41.

support-zoe: Saving customer notes and follow-up actions now.

eng-runtime-jay: Will draft technical RCA and share in #eng-runtime tomorrow.

product-ops-liz: I'll own SDK guidance changes.

sre-anna: Leaving final health checks for 30m, will escalate if anything crops back up.

oncall-rohit: Thanks everyone — good run.
